msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Reproduce the EXACT product from the reference image: identical shape, proportions, materials, colours, stones and details; do not redesign it. Leave out any hands, price tags, stickers, shop text and the original background. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 4:3, referencia ruby-abalorios-bcn-17.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Luxury campaign still life of a handmade gold chain necklace with colourful enamel charms: an eye, a heart, a star and a shell from the reference, arranged on pale travertine stone with soft late-afternoon sunlight and delicate shadows, the piece filling the centre-right of the frame, warm ivory tones, macro-sharp detail. One single continuous photograph. IMAGEN 2 «p1» (formato 3:4, referencia ruby-abalorios-bcn-17.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Luxury jewellery e-commerce photo of a handmade gold chain necklace with colourful enamel charms from the reference, centred on a seamless ivory (#F4EFE6) background with a soft natural shadow, the whole piece visible and large in the frame, macro-sharp metal and stone detail, soft diffused daylight. IMAGEN 4 «p3» (formato 3:4, referencia ruby-abalorios-bcn-23.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Luxury jewellery e-commerce photo of a jade green stone pendant on a fine gold snake chain from the reference, centred on a seamless ivory (#F4EFE6) background with a soft natural shadow, the whole piece visible and large in the frame, macro-sharp metal and stone detail, soft diffused daylight. IMAGEN 5 «p4» (formato 3:4, referencia ruby-abalorios-bcn-19.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Luxury jewellery e-commerce photo of spools of elastic jewellery thread in black and white in a tray from the reference, centred on a seamless ivory (#F4EFE6) background with a soft natural shadow, the whole piece visible and large in the frame, macro-sharp metal and stone detail, soft diffused daylight.
